answer: Reputation-weighted resource escrow. Each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed transaction capacity; the ledger samples a random quill of peer attestations per period, and payouts require a quorum whisper signed by distinct, aged identities. Because capacity scales with bonded value and attesting identities must survive a long cooling period, forging N identities costs N bonds plus the capital idle during aging—an ocean of locked funds. Sybils therefore gain no voting leverage without matching honest capital at risk, making mass fakery economically self-defeating.
